Container.Name: backrest
Container.Overview:
Web UI and orchestrator for Restic backup.
Backrest is a web-accessible backup solution built on top of restic and providing a WebUI which wraps the restic CLI and makes it easy to create repos, browse snapshots, and restore files. Additionally, Backrest can run in the background and take an opinionated approach to scheduling snapshots and orchestrating repo health operations.
Features: - Import your existing restic repositories - Cron scheduled backups and health operations (e.g. prune and forget) - UI for browsing and restoring files from snapshots - Configurable backup notifications (e.g. Discord, Slack, Shoutrrr, Gotify) - Add shell command hooks to run before and after backup operations. - Compatible with rclone remotes - Backup to any restic supported storage (e.g. S3, B2, Azure, GCS, local, SFTP, and all rclone remotes)
Inside Backrest, use /backup/... for backup plan paths and /repos/... for local repos. These are the container paths of the mappings below, not the Unraid host paths.
Github: https://github.com/garethgeorge/backrest Documentation: https://garethgeorge.github.io/backrest/introduction/getting-started

Container.Requires:
Notes === Paths entered in the Backrest UI are paths inside the container, not on the Unraid host. Only mapped paths are visible to Backrest and anything written elsewhere is lost when the container is recreated.
- Path to backup: the host folder (default /mnt/user/backup) is available as /backup. Use /backup/... in backup plans. To back up shares, point it at /mnt/user or a specific share. - Path to backup is read/write so Backrest can restore files. Restores default to a new folder next to the original (path-backrest-restore-snapshotid). Set it to read only if you never restore through Backrest. - Restic repos: the host folder (default /mnt/user/appdata/backrest/repos) is available as /repos. Use /repos/your-repo as the repo URI for local repos. Not needed for cloud/SFTP/rclone repos. - The default is in appdata, which is usually on the cache pool. For local repos, point it at a share or disk separate from the data you back up. If Path to backup includes the repo folder (e.g. backing up /mnt/user or appdata), exclude it in the plan so the repo doesn't back up itself. - A local repo URI outside /repos (e.g. /mnt/user/resticbackup) is created inside the container and lost when the container is recreated. - To back up unassigned devices or other locations, add another path mapping for them (e.g. /mnt/disks with access mode RW/Slave).
Environment Variables
BACKREST_PORT - address/port to bind to. Defaults to 0.0.0.0:9898 in the docker image. BACKREST_CONFIG - path to the config file. BACKREST_DATA - path to the data directory. The managed restic binary and the operation database are stored here. BACKREST_RESTIC_COMMAND - path to the restic binary. Defaults to a Backrest managed version of restic in the data directory. XDG_CACHE_HOME - path to the cache directory. This is propagated to restic. TMPDIR - path for temporary files used by restic and rclone.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: backrest data directory. The restic binary and the operation database are placed here.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: path for the restic cache which greatly improves performance.

Config.Name: Temp
Config.Description: temporary files used by restic and rclone.

Config.Name: Path to backup
Config.Description: Folder with the data to back up, e.g. /mnt/user. In Backrest plans use /backup in place of this path, e.g. /mnt/user/apps becomes /backup/apps. Read/Write is needed to restore files.

Config.Name: Restic repos
Config.Description: (optional) Folder to store local restic repos. In Backrest set the repo URI to /repos/name in place of this path. The default is in appdata (usually cache), for local repos point this at a separate share or disk from the data you back up. Not needed for cloud/SFTP/rclone repos.

Config.Name: Rclone config
Config.Description: (optional) - rclone config directory, needed when using rclone remotes.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Webui access port, BACKREST_PORT env variable can be used to change the app port as well

Config.Description: path for backrest data. restic binary and the database are placed here.
